label: An actual root's absence with an admitted reason is positively fixed (EXPLAINED_ABSENCE_1 to _2)
paraphrase: OPEN sense bridge, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every actual concrete root r at w and every determination d that r lacks at w, if the arena admits some reason at w for the fact lack r d (EXPLAINED_ABSENCE_1), then the absence is positively fixed (EXPLAINED_ABSENCE_2): either no admissible profile contains all of r's real determinations together with d, or some real determination of r requires the lack of a set containing d whose other members r has. It passes between the two senses of EXPLAINED_ABSENCE. Its rationale is that negative facts at a root have positive grounds, the rationale shared with carriage (682e6436), member grounding and E. E alone implies it for every arena (positiveLackReasonsOfNoUnexplainedAbsence); with the PSR for root lack facts, the lack facts and the necessity direction of member grounding it implies E; the reason-essence thesis, carriage and the necessity direction imply it (InquiryScopeMap clause 7).
